flow_summary: The interviewer successfully navigated a long and complex intake with a patient who was occasionally confused or forgetful. While the interviewer was generally effective at guiding the patient, there were a few instances of mechanical or redundant questioning, particularly in the employment section.

issues.evidence: In the employment section, after the patient provided their employment history, the interviewer asked 'Please answer yes or no' which was confusing and redundant given the patient had already provided the information.

The transition from the initial name request to the gender question was abrupt, as the interviewer ignored the patient's confusion regarding their name and simply moved to the next item on the script.
